title: Ndzhuti lowu nga endzhaku ka Xiluvelo
intro: U yime endzeni ka swivava swa mfumo wa matimba wa khale, laha mufumi wa matimba a tivula xikwembu ehenhla ka vanhu hinkwavo. Etlhelo ka mufumi loyi ku yime nandza la tinyiketeleke, la tshembisiweke swikongomelo leswikulu swa mfumo. Swin’we, va kunguhata ni ku kunguhata, va ala ku yingisa switsundzuxo swa murhumiwa loyi a rhumeriweke ku va kongomisa. Xana u nga swi paluxa leswaku nandza loyi wo tshembeka a a ri mani?
clues: A ndzi hanya emfun’weni wa matimba lowu fumiwaka hi munhu wa matimba loyi a a vula leswaku i vukwembu ehenhla ka vanhu hinkwavo.
Ndzi tirhe tanihi mutirheli la tshembekaka wa mufumi loyi, ndzi hetisisa ku navela ka vona kun’wana ni kun’wana ni xileriso xa vona.
Loko murhumiwa wa Allah a ta etikweni ra hina a hi vitana entiyisweni, mina ni mufumi wa mina hi arile ku yingisa.
Ndzi lerisiwe ku lumeka ndzilo lowukulu ni ku lunghiselela switina swa vumba leswaku ku ta akiwa hi ndlela leyikulu.
Mufumi wa mina a a lava ku aka muako lowu tlakukeke swinene lerova wu ta fika ematilweni hi woxe.
Eku heteleleni, mina ni mufumi wa mina, mavuthu ya hina hi khukhuriwile hi nwela evuentweni bya lwandle.

arabic: أَسْبَـٰبَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ فَأَطَّلِعَ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِ مُوسَىٰ وَإِنِّى لَأَظُنُّهُۥ كَـٰذِبًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِفِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ وَصُدَّ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ ۚ وَمَا كَيْدُ فِرْعَوْنَ إِلَّا فِى تَبَابٍۢ
verse: The ways into the heavens - so that I may look at the deity of Moses; but indeed, I think he is a liar." And thus was made attractive to Pharaoh the evil of his deed, and he was averted from the [right] way. And the plan of Pharaoh was not except in ruin. (40:37)
